content: भारद्वाजः [भरद्वाजस्यापत्यम् अण्] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Droṇa, the military preceptor of the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas; यदाश्रौषं व्यूहमभेद्यमन्यैर्भारद्वाजेनात्तशस्त्रेण गुप्तम् <ls>Mb. 1. 1. 190</ls>. .²2 Of Agastya. .²3 The planet Mars. .²4 One of the seven Ṛṣis. .²5 A sky-lark. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of the author on the science of Government mentioned by Kauṭilya; <ls>Kau. A. 1. 15</ls>. .{@-जम्@} A bone. .{@-जी@} The wild cotton shrub. .{@-जाः@} One of the अर्थशास्त्र schools mentioned by Kauṭilya in connection with राजपुत्ररक्षण; <ls>Kau. A. 1. 17</ls>.
